stem: What is one outcome of Mestral’s invention in “Natural Inspiration” that is not shared by the scientists’ invention in “A Brilliant Beetle”?

options.label: F
options.text: Mestral’s invention has proved to be financially successful.

options.label: G
options.text: Mestral’s invention is able to replenish something found in nature.

options.label: H
options.text: Mestral’s invention can be used to solve more than one problem.

options.label: J
options.text: Mestral’s invention inspired new uses beyond its original purpose.
